summary: A six-track groovebox firmware with fourteen synth and drum engines, a 64-step sequencer and a live performance layer. It is a fork of Felucca and loads Felucca's sounds and projects.
features: 14 engines incl. FM6, PHYS, GRAIN, SLICE and DRUM; 148 factory sounds
64-step tracks with chords, ratchets, trig conditions and p-locks
Shared pool of 64 patterns, per-track lists, song mode, 16 scenes
PERFORM page for live launching; FX layer with repeat, tape stop, freeze
USB and TRS MIDI with clock, USB audio, a browser editor
Up to 16 voices on two cores; also runs on the SMK-37 Pro
